text:
Bayern Munich expect Vincent Kompany to miss an extended period as their head coach continues his hospital treatment for a virus after collapsing on the training pitch on Friday. Speaking at a press conference on Saturday, Bayern’s sporting director, Max Eberl, confirmed Kompany was still in hospital in a stable condition.
Kompany’s English assistant coach, Aaron Danks, will replace the 40-year-old for Sunday’s Bundesliga match at Freiburg. Eberl said examinations were continuing to determine the nature of the former Manchester City and Belgium captain’s condition, with a recovery timeframe yet to be determined.
“Vinnie will be given all the time he needs. We’re not starting to put together any timeframes. We need to firstly figure out what it is and then we’ll discuss calmly what recovery time is to be. We won’t be talking about days, but weeks. We need to all be clear on that.”
Taking Saturday’s press conference in Kompany’s absence, Danks said he had spoken with the former centre-back briefly on Friday but only to wish him well. “I explained to him that we wouldn’t be having no football conversations. It was just checking in on his health and making sure he’s OK.”
Danks added: “All the football operations are in our hands and we’ll work together as a team to keep the club moving forward.”
Bayern’s second team’s game was postponed on Friday after Kompany’s collapse but Eberl said the club did not consider trying to postpone Sunday’s Bundesliga game. “I think the greatest joy for Vinnie would be for us to play well tomorrow and, ideally, get a positive result,” Eberl said. “That would probably be one of the best things we could do to help him recover.”
Danks confirmed the Germany captain, Joshua Kimmich, who has been on bereavement leave since Tuesday, would also miss Sunday’s game.
Kompany returned to the dugout for Wednesday’s home Champions League 2-2 draw with Arsenal despite missing the pre-match press conference due to the virus. Speaking after the Arsenal game, Kompany said his body reacted after he tried to push through the illness. “I caught a pretty nasty virus last week, and of course I didn’t listen to my body – and then at some point my body just said: ‘Enough is enough!’”
The defending champions are top of the Bundesliga table at the start of the weekend, level on 14 points with Borussia Dortmund and one ahead of Freiburg and Leverkusen. Bayern’s next Champions League match is on 3 November in Spain against Atlético Madrid.
digest_he: באיירן מינכן הודיעה כי מאמנה וינסנט קומפני צפוי להיעדר לתקופה ארוכה של שבועות עקב טיפול רפואי בבית חולים בעקבות וירוס קשה שגרם לקריסתו על כר הדשא באימון. המנהל הספורטיבי מקס אברל אישר כי קומפני מאושפז במצב יציב, וכי עדיין מוקדם לקבוע לוח זמנים מדויק לחזרתו. עוזר המאמן האנגלי ארון דאנקס יחליף את קומפני על הקווים במשחק הבונדסליגה נגד פרייבורג. המועדון הבהיר כי הבריאות קודמת לכל וכי המאמן יקבל את כל הזמן הדרוש להחלמה מלאה מבלי להפעיל לחץ על חזרתו.
